run_hydra_app: run the Hydra app that prints the resolved configuration as YAML output
create_hydra_config_app: create a Python app using @hydra.main with a config_path and config_name to load YAML configs
test_config_groups: test the Hydra app with config groups like optimizer to verify defaults are resolved
summarize_omegaconf_yaml: summarize the OmegaConf.to_yaml function that converts a DictConfig object to YAML string output
review_hydra_main_decorator: review the @hydra.main decorator usage with version_base, config_path, and config_name parameters
